Create your first AI-powered post now.
About.introContent: Hello. We are Team Synapso, creators of tools to maximize developer productivity. Sharing the process of coding is as important as coding itself. However, we are always pressed for time, and 'documentation' often takes a back seat to 'development'. We are here to solve this problem.
About.backgroundQuote: Why does great engineering work only sleep on GitHub?
About.backgroundContent: Synapso.dev started with this question. Countless developers write innovative code and commit every day, but the thoughts and problem-solving processes behind them are forgotten without being documented. Traditional blogging disrupts the development flow and requires extra energy. We dreamed of a <important>seamless workflow where the act of 'committing' naturally leads to 'documentation'</important>.
About.diff1Desc:
Reverse-engineers requirements, planning, and dev journey from commit history.
AI reconstructs "what and why you built it" — not a summary, a spec restoration.
About.diff2Desc:
Developers add their work intent (userContext) to the AI-restored structure.
AI provides the structure, you provide the soul.
About.diff3Desc: With Cron-based Auto Mode, the moment you push, AI begins analysis in the background and prepares it for publishing.
About.diff4Desc: We do not use your code for AI training. We follow strict security principles where data is discarded immediately after analysis, valuing your code assets.
About.visionQuote: A world where every engineer easily records and shares their impact
About.visionContent: Synapso.dev will provide an experience where technical blogging is no longer a 'chore' but a 'reward'.

Pricing.title:
Focus on Development.
AI handles the writing.
Pricing.desc: Just write code. We analyze your commits and turn them into professional technical posts.
Pricing.faq1A: 100% of the intellectual property rights (including copyright) belong to the user who provided the original data (commits and code). Synapso.dev does not use your code for AI training and deletes it immediately after analysis.
Pricing.faq2Q: Can I use it for free forever?
Pricing.faq2A: Yes, the Basic (Free) plan supports 3 AI post generations per month for free. Upgrade to Pro for more professional and deeper analysis.
Pricing.basicDesc: For students and juniors who write occasionally
Pricing.proDesc: For professional devs building personal brands
